decision: read 'TanStack DB adapter' as this repo's @opfs-lsm/tanstack-db
why: the monorepo ships that adapter and the request sits in this repo

decision: set the scale target at 100k issues with 0-1 comment each
why: LinearLite's own README targets that dataset

decision: based the branch on origin/main, not the current branch
why: current branch has one unmerged kv API commit (dd3efaa)

decision: proved Start + kv over OPFS + node:sqlite load together before designing on them
why: the riskiest infra seam, every later step needs it
evidence: commit 5b3774b; agent-browser: sqlite 3.51.3, rows 0->1, 1 after reload

decision: wrote a seeded generator with LinearLite distributions
why: every scale number needs the same reproducible dataset

decision: ran an architect arena: opus and sonnet runners, judge skipped
why: both cross-judge pool entries are the parent's family

decision: superseded my first 100k spike run: dev server served stale modules
why: vite watcher missed edits under the scratchpad path; seed and index edits never ran

decision: keep issue summaries eager, load descriptions and comments on demand
why: eager bodies cost ~0.5 s more cold start and ~200 MB more heap at 100k

decision: named the cold-open limiter: no single one
why: main thread splits TanStack ingest+BTree ~150ms, kv SST scan ~85ms, JSON decode ~74ms, GC 50ms, OPFS wait ~210ms idle

decision: picked candidate A as base (tables, on-demand by key or prefix, comment key carries issue)
why: A's on-demand plan needs no kv key-layout change; B's partition tag does

decision: grafted from B: dirty clocks on the row, SSE as a hint only, field-assignment push with no dedupe table
why: one outbox per row cannot drift from the row; one data path for live, reconnect and cold start

decision: made every write one kv read-modify-write (utils.transact) instead of TanStack optimistic mutations
why: B's dirty map persisted from a stale tab copy can drop another tab's dirty field; merging inside db.update cannot
result: hypothesis: same-tab visibility within a frame

decision: dropped B's modified-desc bootstrap endpoint for now
why: second data path; only earns its place if first sync is slow, measure first

decision: deferred description search (kv valueContains); title search in memory only
why: not needed for the core loop; both candidates agree it is a kv scan when added

decision: accepted the server slice after rerunning its checks and reading merge.ts and sync.ts
why: the delegate's report is not proof
evidence: commits 8d6d0d4..08aed9b; my rerun: node --test 37/37, tsc clean

decision: accepted delegate deviations: server owns modified/username, a page never splits a version, no-op pushes write nothing
why: each closes a hole the design left open (lost rows at page edge, spoofed authorship)

decision: logged a narrow merge gap: an ack older than an already-pulled version keeps the local value of a confirmed field
why: only a /api/detail fetch racing a description push reaches it; leader pushes before it pulls

decision: seed 100k: 249,734 rows in 2.88 s, 89 MB SQLite; warm pull of 5,000 issues 16-28 ms, 1.18 MB
why: first-sync budget input: ~20 pages of issues

decision: accepted utils.transact and onDemand after rerunning build, 31/31 tests and pnpm static
why: delegate also showed each test fails when its behavior is removed

decision: rebased the adapter branch onto new main (PR 151 landed meanwhile) and stacked feat/linearlite on it
why: app needs transact and onDemand; adapter ships as its own PR under the app
result: 37/37 app tests, tsc clean after rebase

decision: handed the client data layer to one owner on opus with six browser proofs
why: leader loop, merge on write and on-demand reads are coupled; splitting them would need a shared mutable contract

decision: accepted the client data layer after rerunning 49/49 tests, tsc and pnpm static
why: six browser proofs pass; it found and fixed an SSE no-pull bug and a 10k batch cap on reseed

decision: accepted the outbox collection next to dirty-on-row
why: on-demand bodies and comments cannot be scanned for dirty rows; the outbox only names keys, the row stays the truth

decision: kept transact without an optimistic overlay
why: edit to live query p50 2.7 ms (60 edits), DOM 5.6 ms; well under a frame

decision: stamped seed versions newest-modified first
why: first page now holds the default view's rows; issues caught up 6.9 s -> 3.8 s (ranges do not overlap)
result: kept; real servers need a modified-desc bootstrap

decision: accepted the UI after rerunning tests/tsc/static and viewing list, board, detail and offline screenshots
why: screens read through hooks and write through commands; behavior checks reported against the server

decision: repaired warm, visible and offline scenarios broken by the new markup
why: the harness is the lever a reviewer reruns
evidence: commit 814902c; visible dom p50 6.6ms n=60, warm 1844ms n=3, offline acked 274ms

decision: fixed the start script and measured the production build
why: dev numbers carry React dev overhead; the start script pointed at a file Start 1.169 does not emit
result: first rows 153ms, issues caught up 3.4s, warm 1.1s

decision: left edit-latency scenarios dev-only
why: they need a test global; dev numbers are an upper bound, no prod hook shipped

decision: ran the comment review over the stack; restored four adapter comments it deleted from code already on main
why: those lines predate this change; deleting them was out of scope

decision: rejected two reshape flags: outbox mark order helper and deriving CLEAR_CHUNK from kv
why: a mark without a dirty row pushes nothing; kv's 10,000-op cap is not exported

decision: split into four stacked PRs: adapter, app server, app client, app UI
why: each boundary passes tests and tsc on its own
evidence: boundaries 4abde6b and e293185: 37/37 and 49/49, tsc ok

decision: supersedes 'kept transact without an optimistic overlay': the 2.7 ms / 5.6 ms numbers are dev-build; filter and search changes cost 52-170 ms p50
why: trail review flagged the row as reading like production and frame-level for all UX

decision: supersedes 'stamped seed versions newest-modified first': first rows went 298 -> 459 ms p50 (ranges overlap) and the win is a property of seeded data
why: 3 sequential runs per side; a real server needs a modified-desc bootstrap for the same effect

decision: behavior proofs I reran myself: visible, warm, offline (dev) and first-sync, warm (prod); tabs, users and handover are the client delegate's runs only
why: trail review flagged 'accepted per delegate' rows

decision: the trail review ran on sonnet, the same family as the parent
why: no model from another family is available in this harness

decision: found that every warm run of the harness was a first sync
why: agent-browser open --init-script opens the page in a fresh browser context: empty storage, no network route
evidence: probe: /api/pull served 200 with the route set; kv seq 2 at open
result: fixed in the harness: script registered at connect, a warm run that reaches the server fails

decision: kept seven issue indexes: one per sort, search, pending
why: a sort with no index reads and holds all 100k issues; each index costs ~240 ms of first sync
evidence: bench/first-sync-100k.txt: caught-up:issues 4,203 ms with 7, 3,258 ms with 3

decision: a short ordered window takes a boundary once writes fill it
why: the list loads on an empty replica, so it kept every issue a first sync wrote
evidence: commit f07a7f3: TanStack issues 100,000 -> 100, heap 83-185 -> 16-27 MB, caught-up:issues 6,727 -> 6,025 ms

decision: the count hook waits 4x its last read, at least 250 ms, before reading again
why: counting 100k entries after each 666-row slice took up to half the main thread

decision: dropped the outbox collection: bodies and comments get the sparse pending index
why: one way to find unsent rows for every stream; an ack already clears only the fields it confirms
evidence: offline scenario: 5 unsynced, acked 468 ms after reconnect, description and comment on the server

decision: edit scenarios load the row they watch with a live query by id
why: subscribing to a whole on-demand collection asks for every row: 15 s and 100k rows in memory
evidence: visible own edit 3.7 ms p50; tabs 3.1 / 2.5 ms p50

decision: the list total and board counts are keyed by filter and query, not the sort
why: a sort change recounted 100,000 entries and repainted the total
evidence: sort modified <-> created 59.4 -> 14 ms p50, 5 interleaved runs per round (bench/ui-latency-100k.txt)

decision: B loses to A on first sync, the priority sort and the first deep jump; reported, not fixed here
why: seven keys per issue through kv's write path; TanStack's unlimited tie load (19,700 rows); TanStack's prefix load (50,100 rows)
evidence: bench/first-sync-100k.txt, bench/ui-latency-100k.txt read costs, DESIGN.md Measured
